ref: #2 §7.6 (open): whether a SUPPRESS-only context counts as empty for mapWithDefault; #57 ticket: it counts as empty (assumed, #33); obs-context-functions ctx-2 f2.xml decides it (#33); createIf true → "", false → SUPPRESS (#2 §4 [SAP✓]); observation #61
note: To observe in PO (obs-context-functions ctx-2 o2, o4). Tag in its default context Order is false | false, true | (none) | true, so createIf gives SUPPRESS | SUPPRESS, "" | (empty) | "". mapWithDefault takes the SUPPRESS-only context for empty and gives it one D, keeps SUPPRESS, "" (SUPPRESS next to a value), fills the empty context, keeps "": removeContexts gives D, SUPPRESS, "", D, "", and the root's slot skips the SUPPRESS: D, "", D, "". A SUPPRESS-only context kept would give "", D, ""; a D per SUPPRESS slot would give D, D, "", D, "".
